page.layout: One page of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Below the text: "FINIS" and "SOLI DEO GLORIA", both centred. A library stamp and a digitiser's watermark are not transcribed.

main_text.p: {q}Papa (vt vester Episcopus asserit) cum seipsum absoluere non potest, absoluitur à subdito. Audin'? à Subdito quum itaque huic ministerio se Papa subdit, nonnon interea Summus agnosci debeat? Exemplo res fiet dilucidior.Abulenf. To.4.in Matth.pag.178. col.2.

{r}Confessarius (inquis) duas gerit personas, & Iudicis, & Medici.De offic.pag.4 Papa itaque fidem curámque Corporis sui Medico dat; quando igitur Medicus Papae tangit venas, palpat latera, vrinam explorat, & velut in statera ægrotantis humores expendit; deinde ægroto medicamenta præscribit, iubet insolita, consueta prohibet, arguit oblata, execratur exhibita, authoritate & arbitrio suo omnia ordinat, atque disponit; cui Papa, si sanus esse velit, suâ sponte obtemperat; quasi esset Medicus [illegible, ~8 letters]: si vero se ille nimis Medicum esse meminerit, & ministerij oblitus Pontifici se vestro Superiorem iactitaret; quis non ipsum Medicum, (quod pari ratione de Confessario dicendum) tanquàm Medico egentem, ad Anticyras ocyus ablegandum duxerit? Viden', Lector, quàm effoeta & languida sint hæc, quæ Cardinalis affert?
Quanquam quem toto itinere hactenùs vacillantem & hæsitantem experti sumus, mirandum non est, si eundem videamus in extremo actu deficere.

page.notes: Text centred in the lower part: the closing lines "Quanquam quem ..." are set as centred lines and are transcribed as one paragraph. The Greek phrase after "quasi esset Medicus" is set in small italic type and could not be read; it is marked illegible. The reference mark "q" in the text is written as {q}, and "r" as {r}. Mark "col.2." printed in the note is kept. The library stamp (Biblioteca Romana, Vittorio Emanuele) and the "Digitized by Google" watermark are not part of the printed page and are left out.
